objectives.text: Travel to ___apo_ in ____apo_ and see _apothecary_, as the letter you were handed bids
Poison the wine in _npc_'s decanter at _mansion_ in __mansion_
Put the poisoned decanter back in _mansion_
Report to _darkbmember_ in ___darkbmember_

branches.text: The Brotherhood's test: _npc_'s wine, and your hand in it.

choices.text: Face the Brotherhood with _npc_ still alive

branches.text: A novice is owed a single gold coin for the first sanctioned death.

outcomes.text: _npc_'s heart failed. You are a Brother of the Dark Brotherhood, and one gold coin the richer.
_npc_'s heart failed, and your first coin went to Mephala. The Brotherhood marks such devotion.
_npc_ still lives. Someone must die once a contract is accepted, and the Brotherhood's blades came for you.
The Brotherhood's invitation went unanswered. It will remember.

objectives.text: Find and slay the traitor hiding in ___mondun_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The traitor is settled, protesting to the last that the real traitor was someone else.
The traitor still breathes, and your honor is forfeit.

objectives.text: Get =target_'s hiding place out of _snitch_, the squealer at __snitch_ in ___snitch_
Account =target_ in ___mondung_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: =target_ failed the Brotherhood once. There was no second time.
=target_ slipped the accounting, for now.

objectives.text: Account =assassin_, the freelance assassin at work in ___mondung_
Account =assassin_'s employer, =boss_, in ___stronghold_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: =assassin_ and =boss_ are both accounted, and the Brotherhood's monopoly stands.
=assassin_ is dead but =boss_ lives. The Brotherhood called it enough, and paid nothing.
=assassin_ still undercuts the Brotherhood.

objectives.text: Account the renegade mage =mage_ in ___mondung_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: =mage_'s light is snuffed out, and the Brotherhood and the Mages Guild are both pleased.
The renegade mage still rampages.

objectives.text: Account the bard =monster_, hiding in ___mondung_
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ for your fee

outcomes.text: The bard's requiem is sung, and the duke's daughter will hear no more limericks.
The bard is still singing.

objectives.text: Ask _contact_, =target_'s cousin, at __contact_ in ___contact_ where =target_ went
Find =target_ in ___mondung_ and do the accounting
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: =target_ was no deserter but a vampire, and is at rest now. See a temple before you join the family.
=target_'s absence went unaccounted.

objectives.text: Slay the knight without honor in his fortress, ___mondung_
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

outcomes.text: The caddish knight has entered the hereafter, insulting _damsel_ to the last.
The knight still lives, and the damsel's contract goes unanswered.

objectives.text: Account the wizard who never leaves the Mages Guild of __mondung_
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

outcomes.text: The hated wizard died in the Mages Guild's own hall. You may keep that grin.
The sorcerer still lives.

objectives.text: Account the mark with a scar on the left cheek at _mondung_ in ___mondung_
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ for your payment

outcomes.text: The scarred mark is dead, the client is still nameless, and the questor feels a ballad coming on.
The scarred mark still walks _mondung_.

objectives.text: Account _knight_ at _mondung_ in ___mondung_. _knight_ is no pampered princeling.
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

branches.text: Your client sits a step nearer the throne. Your fee: in gold, or as a royal debt to the Brotherhood?

choices.text: Let the debt stand, for a royal debtor is worth more than gold

outcomes.text: _knight_ will never rule, and the fee is yours.
_knight_ will never rule, and a royal of ___mondung_ now owes the Brotherhood.
_knight_ lives, and may yet worm a way to the throne.

objectives.text: Assassinate _marknpc_ in ___questgiver_. He moves around a lot, and keeps bodyguards.
Pay _mistress_ the fifty gold she asked to sell out _marknpc_
Catch _marknpc_ alone at _mistresshome_ around six o'clock
Return to _questgiver_ for your guild fee

branches.text: _marknpc_'s mistress will sell him out for fifty gold.

outcomes.text: Fifty gold bought an hour of _marknpc_'s time from his own mistress, and you spent it well.
You would not buy _marknpc_ from his mistress, and found him anyway. The Brotherhood respects a hunter.
_marknpc_ fell, bodyguards, spells and all. The Thieves Guild has one schemer fewer.
Seven days passed, and _marknpc_ still moves around ___questgiver_.

objectives.text: Account the war hero at _mondung_ in ___mondung_. You will know the mark by the limp.
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

branches.text: The hero of Betony is dead. Take the fee, or pay for the mark's rites as the old accounters did?

choices.text: Take the fee, for heroes die like anyone else
Spend it on the veteran's rites

outcomes.text: The hero of Betony is dead, and the fee is yours.
The hero of Betony is dead, and buried with rites your fee paid for. The old accounters would approve.
The veteran of Betony still limps through ___mondung_.
